## Data access and reproducibility

The terrace inventory and the survey polygon are loaded directly from the `Rdata`
folder of the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/luismiguelsoto/Architectural_uniformity_and_spatial_variation_in_Tairona_residential_terraces_of_the_Rio_Frio_basin/tree/main/Rdata).
The default Git reference is `main`; set `RIOFRIO_GITHUB_REF` to a commit SHA to
reproduce a fixed repository version. Public repositories require no credentials.
For private access, set `GITHUB_PAT` in your personal `.Renviron` file (or provide
`GH_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_TOKEN` in the environment) using a token with read access to
repository contents, then restart R. Never include a token in this notebook or
commit it to the repository.

The original terrain analyses require the same `FINAL_DEM_GENERAL_ALOS_PALSAR.tif`
used in V7. This raster is not one of the two RData files shown in the repository.
The notebook retains the original local DEM search paths; alternatively, set
`RIOFRIO_DEM_FILE` to the full path of that raster. Terrain analyses remain enabled
by default. The notebook stops if the required raster is unavailable rather than
silently dropping terrain analyses or substituting a different elevation model.

```{r chunk-03-helpers}
# 03. Reporting and plotting helpers
fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 4L) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  out <- rep("NA", length(x))
  ok <- is.finite(x)
  int_like <- ok & abs(x - round(x)) < 1e-9 & abs(x) < 1e12
  out[int_like] <- sprintf("%.0f", round(x[int_like]))
  dec <- ok & !int_like
  out[dec] <- trimws(formatC(x[dec], digits = digits, format = "g"))
  inf <- !ok & !is.na(x)
  out[inf] <- as.character(x[inf])
  out
}
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  p <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(p))
  ifelse(is.finite(p), trimws(formatC(p, digits = 2, format = "fg")), "NA")
}
fmt_value <- function(v, digits = 4L) {
  if (is.factor(v)) v <- as.character(v)
  if (is.logical(v)) return(ifelse(is.na(v), "NA", ifelse(v, "TRUE", "FALSE")))
  if (is.numeric(v)) return(fmt_num(v, digits))
  v <- as.character(v)
  v[is.na(v)] <- "NA"
  gsub(";", ",", v, fixed = TRUE)
}
interval_text <- function(lo, hi, digits = 4L) paste(fmt_num(lo, digits), "to", fmt_num(hi, digits))
vector_text <- function(x, digits = 4L) paste(fmt_value(x, digits), collapse = ", ")
hard_split <- function(s, width) {
  n <- nchar(s, type = "chars")
  if (n <= width) return(s)
  starts <- seq(1L, n, by = width)
  substring(s, starts, pmin(starts + width - 1L, n))
}
split_long <- function(s, width, indent) {
  if (nchar(s, type = "width") <= width) return(s)
  lead <- nchar(s) - nchar(sub("^ +", "", s))
  w <- strwrap(s, width = width, indent = lead, exdent = max(lead, indent))
  unlist(lapply(w, hard_split, width = width), use.names = FALSE)
}
pack_fields <- function(f, width = REPORT_WIDTH, indent = 4L) {
  out <- character(); cur <- ""
  for (x in f) {
    trial <- if (nzchar(cur)) paste0(cur, "; ", x) else x
    if (nchar(trial, type = "width") <= width) { cur <- trial; next }
    if (nzchar(cur)) out <- c(out, cur)
    cur <- paste0(if (length(out)) strrep(" ", indent) else "", x)
  }
  if (nzchar(cur)) out <- c(out, cur)
  unlist(lapply(out, split_long, width = width, indent = indent), use.names = FALSE)
}
emit_rows <- function(...) {
  x <- list(...)
  n <- max(vapply(x, length, integer(1)))
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    f <- vapply(seq_along(x), function(j) {
      v <- x[[j]]
      paste0(names(x)[j], "=", fmt_value(v[if (length(v) == 1L) 1L else i]))
    }, character(1))
    writeLines(pack_fields(f))
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
emit_text <- function(key, text) {
  for (s in text) writeLines(pack_fields(paste0(key, "=", gsub(";", ",", s, fixed = TRUE))))
  invisible(NULL)
}
report_start <- function(id, shows, encoding) {
  writeLines(pack_fields(c(paste0("REPORT=", id), paste0("SHOWS=", shows))))
  emit_text("ENCODING", encoding)
}
heading <- function(text, level = 1L) {
  cat("\n\n", strrep("#", level), " ", text, "\n\n", sep = "")
}
check_caption <- function(s) { stopifnot(nchar(s, type = "chars") < 400L); s }
print_caption <- function(kind, number, caption) {
  caption <- sub("[.][[:space:]]*$", "", check_caption(caption))
  label <- if (kind == "Figure") "Fig." else kind
  cat("\n\n**", label, " ", number, "** ", caption, "\n\n", sep = "")
}
latex_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("([&%$#_{}])", "\\\\\\1", x)
  x <- gsub("~", "\\textasciitilde{}", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("^", "\\textasciicircum{}", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}
latex_table <- function(df, total = 0.92, chars_per_line = 90) {
  m <- as.matrix(df); storage.mode(m) <- "character"; m[is.na(m)] <- "NA"
  cells <- rbind(names(df), m)
  words <- apply(cells, 2, function(col)
    max(nchar(unlist(strsplit(col, "[[:space:]]+"))), 1L))
  avg <- apply(cells, 2, function(col) mean(nchar(col)))
  base <- words + 1
  spare <- max(0, chars_per_line - sum(base))
  extra <- pmax(avg - base, 0)
  w <- base + if (sum(extra) > 0) spare * extra / sum(extra) else spare / length(base)
  w <- w / sum(w) * total
  spec <- paste0("@{}", paste0(">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{", sprintf("%.3f", w),
                               "\\linewidth}", collapse = ""), "@{}")
  body <- matrix(latex_escape(m), nrow = nrow(m))
  rows <- apply(body, 1, function(r) paste0(paste(r, collapse = " & "), " \\\\"))
  c("\\begingroup\\small", "\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{3pt}",
    paste0("\\begin{longtable}{", spec, "}"), "\\toprule",
    paste0(paste(latex_escape(names(df)), collapse = " & "), " \\\\"), "\\midrule",
    "\\endhead", "\\bottomrule", "\\endlastfoot", rows, "\\end{longtable}", "\\endgroup")
}
print_table <- function(df) {
  if (isTRUE(knitr::is_latex_output())) {
    cat("\n", paste(latex_table(df), collapse = "\n"), "\n\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    cat("\n\n"); print(knitr::kable(df, format = "pipe")); cat("\n\n")
  }
}
qv <- function(x, p = c(.025, .5, .975)) as.numeric(stats::quantile(x, p, names = FALSE))
mc_p <- function(obs, sim) {
  min(1, 2 * min((1 + sum(sim <= obs)) / (length(sim) + 1),
                 (1 + sum(sim >= obs)) / (length(sim) + 1)))
}
tint <- function(col, f = 0.7) {
  m <- grDevices::col2rgb(col) / 255
  grDevices::rgb(t(m + (1 - m) * f))
}
COL <- c(observed = "#440154", reference = "#3B528B", global = "#21908C", regional = "#5DC863",
         outside = "#F89540", fit = "#D7191C", neutral = "black")
theme_v7 <- function() {
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(text = element_text(colour = "black"),
          line = element_line(colour = "black"),
          rect = element_rect(colour = "black"),
          legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical", legend.title.position = "top",
          legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), legend.key.size = grid::unit(3.5, "mm"),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 7.5, colour = "black"),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 7.5, colour = "black"),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black"),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 7.5, colour = "black"),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 7, colour = "black"),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "black"),
          axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black"),
          plot.title = element_text(colour = "black"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "black"),
          plot.caption = element_text(colour = "black"),
          plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, colour = "black"),
          plot.margin = margin(3, 5, 3, 3))
}
save_figure <- function(plot, name, height_mm) {
  stopifnot(height_mm <= 234, name %in% names(FIG_HEIGHT_MM))
  file <- file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(name, ".pdf"))
  ggplot2::ggsave(file, plot, width = FIG_WIDTH_MM, height = height_mm, units = "mm",
                  device = grDevices::pdf, bg = "white", useDingbats = FALSE)
  file
}
band_text <- function(meta) paste0(fmt_num(meta$Lower_m), "-", fmt_num(meta$Upper_m))
bands_outside <- function(bt, flag) if (any(flag)) paste(bt[flag], collapse = ", ") else "none"
outside_runs <- function(x, flag) {
  flag <- as.logical(flag)
  if (!any(flag)) return("none")
  r <- rle(flag)
  ends <- cumsum(r$lengths)
  starts <- ends - r$lengths + 1L
  s <- starts[r$values]
  e <- ends[r$values]
  paste(ifelse(s == e, fmt_num(x[s]), paste0(fmt_num(x[s]), "-", fmt_num(x[e]))),
        collapse = ",")
}
value_at <- function(df, at, col = "Observed") {
  vapply(at, function(z) df[[col]][which.min(abs(df$Distance_m - z))], numeric(1))
}
envelope_at <- function(df, at) {
  k <- which.min(abs(df$Distance_m - at))
  interval_text(df$Low[k], df$High[k], 3)
}
```

```{r chunk-04-parallel-setup}
# 04. Parallel computation and internal cache
if (exists("CLUSTER", inherits = FALSE) && inherits(CLUSTER, "cluster")) {
  try(parallel::stopCluster(CLUSTER), silent = TRUE)
}
CLUSTER <- NULL
logical_processors <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(parallel::detectCores(logical = TRUE)))
if (!is.finite(logical_processors) || logical_processors < 1L) logical_processors <- 2L
physical_processors <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE)))
if (!is.finite(physical_processors) || physical_processors < 1L) {
  physical_processors <- logical_processors
}
requested_workers <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(Sys.getenv("RIOFRIO_WORKERS", "")))
CPU_WORKERS <- if (!isTRUE(RUN_PARALLEL)) {
  1L
} else if (is.finite(requested_workers) && requested_workers >= 1L) {
  min(requested_workers, logical_processors)
} else {
  max(1L, logical_processors - 2L)
}
if (QUICK_TEST) CPU_WORKERS <- min(CPU_WORKERS, 2L)
PARALLEL_BLOCKS <- CPU_WORKERS
USE_CACHE <- env_true("RIOFRIO_CACHE", "TRUE")
CACHE_DIR <- Sys.getenv("RIOFRIO_CACHE_DIR", tools::R_user_dir("riofrio_terraces", "cache"))
if (USE_CACHE) dir.create(CACHE_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
CACHE_FINGERPRINT <- c(R.version.string, "per-realization seeds",
                       vapply(req, function(p) paste(p, as.character(utils::packageVersion(p))),
                              character(1)))
MC_LOG <- data.frame(Label = character(), B = integer(), Cached = logical(),
                     Seconds = numeric())
hash_object <- function(x) {
  f <- tempfile(fileext = ".bin")
  on.exit(unlink(f), add = TRUE)
  writeBin(serialize(x, NULL, version = 3L), f)
  unname(tools::md5sum(f))
}
mc_worker <- function(ids, callback, p, seed0) {
  values <- lapply(ids, function(k) {
    set.seed(seed0 + k)
    z <- callback(k, p)
    if (!is.numeric(z) || any(!is.finite(z))) stop("Invalid realization ", k)
    as.numeric(z)
  })
  list(ids = ids, values = do.call(rbind, values))
}
environment(mc_worker) <- baseenv()
cache_file <- function(B, step, payload, seed, label) {
  is_fun <- vapply(payload, is.function, logical(1))
  code <- c(deparse(mc_worker), deparse(step),
            unlist(lapply(payload[is_fun], deparse), use.names = FALSE))
  key <- hash_object(list(label, as.integer(seed), as.integer(B), CACHE_FINGERPRINT, code,
                          names(payload), payload[!is_fun]))
  file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", label), "_", key, ".rds"))
}
get_cluster <- function() {
  if (CPU_WORKERS < 2L) return(NULL)
  alive <- !is.null(CLUSTER) &&
    isTRUE(tryCatch(all(unlist(parallel::clusterCall(CLUSTER, function() TRUE))),
                    error = function(e) FALSE))
  if (!alive) {
    CLUSTER <<- tryCatch(parallel::makeCluster(CPU_WORKERS, type = "PSOCK"),
                         error = function(e) {
                           warning("PSOCK unavailable: ", conditionMessage(e))
                           NULL
                         })
    if (!is.null(CLUSTER)) {
      parallel::clusterCall(CLUSTER, function() {
        Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1", MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1",
                   BLIS_NUM_THREADS = "1")
        if (requireNamespace("RhpcBLASctl", quietly = TRUE)) {
          RhpcBLASctl::blas_set_num_threads(1L)
          RhpcBLASctl::omp_set_num_threads(1L)
        }
        NULL
      })
    }
  }
  CLUSTER
}
mc_run <- function(B, step, payload, seed, label) {
  stopifnot(B >= 1L, seed + B < .Machine$integer.max)
  environment(step) <- baseenv()
  started <- Sys.time()
  file <- if (USE_CACHE) cache_file(B, step, payload, seed, label) else NA_character_
  m <- NULL
  if (USE_CACHE && file.exists(file)) {
    m <- tryCatch(readRDS(file), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.matrix(m) || nrow(m) != B || !all(is.finite(m))) m <- NULL
  }
  cached <- !is.null(m)
  if (!cached) {
    tasks <- split(seq_len(B), rep(seq_len(min(B, PARALLEL_BLOCKS)), length.out = B))
    cl <- if (length(tasks) > 1L) get_cluster() else NULL
    out <- if (is.null(cl)) {
      lapply(tasks, mc_worker, callback = step, p = payload, seed0 = seed)
    } else {
      parallel::parLapply(cl, tasks, mc_worker, callback = step, p = payload, seed0 = seed)
    }
    ids <- unlist(lapply(out, `[[`, "ids"), use.names = FALSE)
    m <- do.call(rbind, lapply(out, `[[`, "values"))[order(ids), , drop = FALSE]
    stopifnot(identical(sort(ids), seq_len(B)), nrow(m) == B, all(is.finite(m)))
    if (USE_CACHE) saveRDS(m, file)
  }
  MC_LOG <<- rbind(MC_LOG, data.frame(Label = label, B = B, Cached = cached,
                                      Seconds = round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), started,
                                                                          units = "secs")), 1)))
  m
}
emit_rows(PARALLEL = if (CPU_WORKERS > 1L) "PSOCK, persistent" else "serial",
          LOGICAL_PROCESSORS = logical_processors, PHYSICAL_PROCESSORS = physical_processors,
          WORKERS = CPU_WORKERS, QUICK_TEST = QUICK_TEST, RESULTS_FOR_INFERENCE = !QUICK_TEST)
emit_rows(TERRAIN_MARKS = USE_DEM_MARKS, TERRAIN_INTENSITY = USE_DEM_INTENSITY,
          CALIBRATION = RUN_CALIBRATION, N_PRIMARY = N_PERM, N_SENSITIVITY = N_SENS)
emit_rows(CACHE = USE_CACHE, CACHE_DIR = CACHE_DIR)
emit_text("R_VERSION", R.version.string)
```

```{r chunk-06-inputs}
# 06. Download GitHub RData files and validate spatial inputs
# Keep the original local resolver exclusively for the DEM.
search_dirs <- unique(Filter(nzchar, c(DATA_DIR_OVERRIDE, DATA_DIR_PREFERRED, getwd(),
                                       EXTRA_DATA_DIR)))
resolve_input <- function(file) {
  candidates <- if (grepl("^([A-Za-z]:|/)", file)) file else file.path(search_dirs, file)
  found <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (!length(found)) {
    stop("DEM not found: ", file, ". Searched: ", paste(search_dirs, collapse = " | "),
         ". Set RIOFRIO_DEM_FILE to the original raster's full path.")
  }
  normalizePath(found[1], winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}
GITHUB_INPUT_DIR <- tempfile("aas_rio_frio_github_")
if (!dir.create(GITHUB_INPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)) {
  stop("Unable to create a temporary directory for GitHub inputs")
}

download_github_rdata <- function(file) {
  stopifnot(nzchar(GITHUB_REF), basename(file) == file)
  # Read credentials from the environment only; never print or save them.
  tokens <- Sys.getenv(c("GITHUB_PAT", "GH_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN"), unset = "")
  tokens <- unname(tokens[nzchar(tokens)])
  token <- if (length(tokens)) tokens[1] else ""
  ref <- utils::URLencode(GITHUB_REF, reserved = TRUE)
  remote_path <- paste(GITHUB_FOLDER, file, sep = "/")
  handle <- curl::new_handle(connecttimeout = 30L, timeout = 300L,
                              followlocation = TRUE)
  if (nzchar(token)) {
    # GitHub Contents API returns the binary file with this media type.
    remote_url <- paste0("https://api.github.com/repos/", GITHUB_OWNER, "/",
                         GITHUB_REPO, "/contents/", remote_path, "?ref=", ref)
    curl::handle_setheaders(handle, Authorization = paste("Bearer", token),
                            Accept = "application/vnd.github.raw+json",
                            `X-GitHub-Api-Version` = "2022-11-28",
                            `User-Agent` = "AAS-RIO-FRIO-2026")
  } else {
    remote_url <- paste0("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/", GITHUB_OWNER, "/",
                         GITHUB_REPO, "/", ref, "/", remote_path)
  }
  dest <- file.path(GITHUB_INPUT_DIR, file)
  response <- tryCatch(curl::curl_fetch_disk(remote_url, dest, handle = handle),
                       error = function(e) {
                         unlink(dest)
                         stop("GitHub download failed for ", file, ": ",
                              conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE)
                       })
  if (response$status_code != 200L || !file.exists(dest) ||
      !isTRUE(file.info(dest)$size > 0)) {
    unlink(dest)
    stop("GitHub download failed for ", file, " (HTTP ", response$status_code,
         "). Check the repository, reference, path, and read permissions. ",
         "For a private repository, configure GITHUB_PAT and restart R.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  normalizePath(dest, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}

read_sf_rdata <- function(path) {
  # Isolate serialized objects from the notebook's analysis environment.
  e <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  object_names <- tryCatch(load(path, envir = e), error = function(err) {
    stop("Invalid RData file ", basename(path), ": ", conditionMessage(err),
         call. = FALSE)
  })
  sf_names <- object_names[vapply(object_names, function(nm) {
    inherits(get(nm, envir = e, inherits = FALSE), "sf")
  }, logical(1))]
  if (length(sf_names) != 1L) {
    stop("Expected exactly one sf object in ", basename(path), "; found ",
         length(sf_names), ". Objects: ", paste(object_names, collapse = ", "),
         call. = FALSE)
  }
  get(sf_names[1], envir = e, inherits = FALSE)
}

terrace_path <- download_github_rdata(TERRACES_FILE)
polygon_path <- download_github_rdata(POLYGON_FILE)
architecture <- read_sf_rdata(terrace_path)
survey <- read_sf_rdata(polygon_path)
for (obj in list(architecture, survey)) {
  if (!identical(as.integer(sf::st_crs(obj)$epsg), EXPECTED_CRS)) {
    stop("Inputs must use EPSG:32618")
  }
  if (any(sf::st_is_empty(obj)) || !all(sf::st_is_valid(obj) %in% TRUE)) {
    stop("Invalid or empty input geometry")
  }
}
architecture <- sf::st_zm(architecture, drop = TRUE, what = "ZM")
survey <- sf::st_zm(survey, drop = TRUE, what = "ZM")
stopifnot(all(as.character(sf::st_geometry_type(architecture)) == "POINT"),
          all(as.character(sf::st_geometry_type(survey)) %in% c("POLYGON", "MULTIPOLYGON")))
needed_fields <- c(ID_FIELD, DIAMETER_FIELD, EAST_FIELD, NORTH_FIELD)
if (length(setdiff(needed_fields, names(architecture)))) {
  stop("Missing fields: ", paste(setdiff(needed_fields, names(architecture)), collapse = ", "))
}
survey_union <- sf::st_union(sf::st_geometry(survey))
inside <- lengths(sf::st_covered_by(architecture, survey_union)) > 0L
if (nrow(architecture) != EXPECTED_TERRACES || any(!inside)) {
  stop("Expected ", EXPECTED_TERRACES, " terraces inside the survey polygon; found ",
       nrow(architecture), " rows and ", sum(!inside), " outside")
}
attr_xy <- cbind(as.numeric(architecture[[EAST_FIELD]]), as.numeric(architecture[[NORTH_FIELD]]))
geom_xy <- sf::st_coordinates(architecture)[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
coord_gap <- sqrt(rowSums((attr_xy - geom_xy)^2))
if (any(!is.finite(coord_gap)) || max(coord_gap) > COORD_TOL_M) {
  stop("Coordinate fields and point geometry disagree")
}
terraces <- data.frame(Terrace_ID = trimws(as.character(architecture[[ID_FIELD]])),
                       X = geom_xy[, 1], Y = geom_xy[, 2],
                       Diameter_m = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(
                         architecture[[DIAMETER_FIELD]]))))
if (anyNA(terraces$Terrace_ID) || any(!nzchar(terraces$Terrace_ID)) ||
    anyDuplicated(terraces$Terrace_ID)) {
  stop("Missing or duplicated terrace IDs")
}
if (any(!is.finite(as.matrix(terraces[, c("X", "Y", "Diameter_m")]))) ||
    any(terraces$Diameter_m <= 0)) {
  stop("Invalid coordinates or diameters")
}
if (anyDuplicated(terraces[, c("X", "Y")])) stop("Coincident terrace centers")
ord <- order(terraces$Terrace_ID)
terraces <- terraces[ord, ]
architecture <- architecture[ord, ]
rownames(terraces) <- NULL
D <- terraces$Diameter_m
n <- length(D)
D_ORIGINAL <- D
terraces$Area_equiv_m2 <- pi * D^2 / 4
area_km2 <- as.numeric(sf::st_area(survey_union)) / 1e6
if (abs(area_km2 - EXPECTED_AREA_KM2) > 0.05) stop("Unexpected survey area")
bb <- sf::st_bbox(survey_union)
origin <- c(as.numeric(bb["xmin"]), as.numeric(bb["ymin"]))
W <- spatstat.geom::shift(spatstat.geom::as.owin(survey_union), vec = -origin)
xy_local <- sweep(as.matrix(terraces[, c("X", "Y")]), 2, origin, "-")
Xpp <- spatstat.geom::ppp(xy_local[, 1], xy_local[, 2], window = W, check = TRUE)
if (Xpp$n != n || abs(spatstat.geom::area.owin(W) / 1e6 - area_km2) > 0.01) {
  stop("Observation window conversion failed")
}
edge_m <- as.numeric(sf::st_distance(architecture, sf::st_boundary(survey_union)))
set.seed(SEED + 100L)
regions <- stats::kmeans(xy_local, centers = LOO_REGIONS, nstart = 25, iter.max = 200)$cluster
```

```{r chunk-07-terrain}
# 07. Terrain covariates
terrain_cov <- list()
terrain_at <- NULL
terrain_raw <- NULL
dem_path <- NULL
dem_info <- NULL
if (USE_DEM) {
  dem_path <- resolve_input(DEM_FILE)
  dem <- terra::rast(dem_path)
  if (terra::nlyr(dem) != 1L || !nzchar(terra::crs(dem))) {
    stop("The DEM must be one georeferenced elevation layer")
  }
  native_res <- terra::res(dem)
  native_crs <- tryCatch(as.character(terra::crs(dem, describe = TRUE)$code),
                         error = function(e) NA_character_)
  aoi_native <- sf::st_bbox(sf::st_transform(sf::st_buffer(survey_union, 2000),
                                             sf::st_crs(terra::crs(dem))))
  dem <- terra::crop(dem, terra::ext(as.numeric(aoi_native[c("xmin", "xmax", "ymin", "ymax")])))
  dem <- terra::project(dem, "EPSG:32618", method = "bilinear", res = DEM_RES_M)
  dem <- terra::crop(dem, terra::ext(as.numeric(bb["xmin"]) - 1000, as.numeric(bb["xmax"]) + 1000,
                                     as.numeric(bb["ymin"]) - 1000, as.numeric(bb["ymax"]) + 1000))
  win <- max(3L, 2L * floor(DEM_SCALE_M / (2 * terra::res(dem)[1])) + 1L)
  sm <- terra::focal(dem, w = win, fun = "mean", na.rm = TRUE)
  sl <- terra::terrain(sm, v = "slope", unit = "degrees", neighbors = 8)
  ras <- c(sm, sl, dem - sm)
  names(ras) <- c("elev", "slope", "tpi")
  vals <- as.data.frame(terra::extract(ras, as.matrix(terraces[, c("X", "Y")])))
  vals <- vals[, names(ras), drop = FALSE]
  if (any(!is.finite(as.matrix(vals)))) stop("The DEM does not cover every terrace center")
  terrain_raw <- vals
  terrain_at <- as.data.frame(scale(vals))
  names(terrain_at) <- names(ras)
  if (qr(cbind(1, as.matrix(terrain_at)))$rank < 4L) stop("Terrain covariates are collinear")
  if (USE_DEM_INTENSITY) {
    for (nm in names(ras)) {
      rr <- ras[[nm]]
      mat <- as.matrix(rr, wide = TRUE)
      xx <- terra::xFromCol(rr, seq_len(ncol(mat))) - origin[1]
      yy <- rev(terra::yFromRow(rr, seq_len(nrow(mat)))) - origin[2]
      mat <- (mat[nrow(mat):1, , drop = FALSE] - mean(vals[[nm]])) / stats::sd(vals[[nm]])
      inside_win <- spatstat.geom::inside.owin(rep(xx, each = length(yy)),
                                               rep(yy, times = length(xx)), W)
      if (any(!is.finite(as.vector(mat)[inside_win]))) {
        stop("Missing DEM values inside the survey window")
      }
      terrain_cov[[nm]] <- spatstat.geom::im(mat, xcol = xx, yrow = yy)
    }
  }
  dem_info <- list(file = basename(dem_path), native_res = native_res, native_crs = native_crs,
                   window_cells = win, cell_m = terra::res(dem)[1])
}
```

```{r chunk-11-fig3-compute}
gini <- function(x) {
  x <- sort(x); k <- length(x)
  sum((2 * seq_len(k) - k - 1) * x) / (k * sum(x))
}
qd <- qv(D, c(.05, .25, .5, .75, .95))
diam_freq <- data.frame(Diameter_m = sort(unique(D)))
diam_freq$Terraces <- tabulate(match(D, diam_freq$Diameter_m), nrow(diam_freq))
diam_summary <- data.frame(Mean = mean(D), SD = stats::sd(D), Median = qd[3], Q1 = qd[2],
                           Q3 = qd[4], MAD = stats::mad(D), Min = min(D), Max = max(D),
                           P05 = qd[1], P95 = qd[5], CV = 100 * stats::sd(D) / mean(D),
                           Gini_D = gini(D), Gini_area = gini(terraces$Area_equiv_m2),
                           Share_typical = mean(D >= TYPICAL_DIAMETER_M[1] &
                                                  D <= TYPICAL_DIAMETER_M[2]))
```

```{r chunk-16-distances}
# 16. Pairwise distances and close pairs
DM <- as.matrix(stats::dist(xy_local))
diag(DM) <- Inf
nn_dist <- DM[cbind(seq_len(n), max.col(-DM, ties.method = "first"))]
GAP <- DM - outer(D, D, "+") / 2
min_gap <- GAP[cbind(seq_len(n), max.col(-GAP, ties.method = "first"))]
overlap_pairs <- sum(GAP[upper.tri(GAP)] < 0)
rm(GAP)
close_audit <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(2, 5, 10), function(r) {
  ij <- which(upper.tri(DM) & DM < r, arr.ind = TRUE)
  data.frame(Threshold_m = r, Pairs = nrow(ij), Terraces = length(unique(as.vector(ij))))
}))
close2 <- which(upper.tri(DM) & DM < CLOSE_LIMIT_M, arr.ind = TRUE)
component <- seq_len(n)
for (k in seq_len(nrow(close2))) {
  a <- component[close2[k, 1]]
  b <- component[close2[k, 2]]
  if (a != b) component[component == b] <- a
}
close_vertices <- sort(unique(as.vector(close2)))
close_groups <- split(close_vertices, component[close_vertices])
close_keep <- vapply(close_groups, min, integer(1))
keep_no_close <- setdiff(seq_len(n), close_vertices)
keep_one_close <- setdiff(seq_len(n), setdiff(close_vertices, close_keep))
```

```{r chunk-17-concentration}
# 17. Local concentration
concentration <- function(radius) {
  count <- rowSums(DM <= radius)
  area <- rep(pi * radius^2, n)
  e <- which(edge_m < radius)
  if (length(e)) {
    buffers <- sf::st_buffer(sf::st_geometry(architecture[e, ]), radius, nQuadSegs = 60)
    for (k in seq_along(e)) {
      area[e[k]] <- sum(as.numeric(sf::st_area(suppressWarnings(
        sf::st_intersection(buffers[k], survey_union)))))
    }
  }
  if (any(!is.finite(area) | area <= 0)) stop("Invalid neighborhood area")
  data.frame(Radius_m = radius, Count = count, Area_ha = area / 1e4,
             Concentration = count / (area / 1e4))
}
conc <- setNames(lapply(CONCENTRATION_RADII_M, concentration), as.character(CONCENTRATION_RADII_M))
conc_audit <- do.call(rbind, lapply(conc, function(z) {
  data.frame(Radius_m = z$Radius_m[1], Median_count = stats::median(z$Count),
             P25 = qv(z$Concentration, .25), P75 = qv(z$Concentration, .75))
}))
primary <- conc[[as.character(PRIMARY_RADIUS_M)]]
```

```{r chunk-18-fig4-compute}
# 18. Figure 4 compute
win_sf <- sf::st_sf(geometry = survey_union)
region_hulls <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(LOO_REGIONS), function(g) {
  pts <- as.matrix(terraces[regions == g, c("X", "Y")])
  h <- grDevices::chull(pts)
  data.frame(Region = g, X = pts[h, 1], Y = pts[h, 2])
}))
region_labels <- data.frame(Region = seq_len(LOO_REGIONS),
                            X = as.numeric(tapply(terraces$X, regions, mean)),
                            Y = as.numeric(tapply(terraces$Y, regions, mean)))
diam_labels <- c(paste(fmt_num(min(D)), "to 7"), "8 to 9", "10 to 11", "12 to 13",
                 paste("14 to", fmt_num(max(D))))
map_pts <- data.frame(X = terraces$X, Y = terraces$Y, Diameter_m = D,
                      Class = cut(D, breaks = c(-Inf, 7, 9, 11, 13, Inf), labels = diam_labels),
                      Concentration = primary$Concentration, Region = regions)
log_d <- log(D)
near_matrix <- (DM < NEAR_MAX_M) * 1
near_n <- rowSums(near_matrix)
near_sq <- pmax(near_n * log_d^2 - 2 * log_d * as.numeric(near_matrix %*% log_d) +
                  as.numeric(near_matrix %*% log_d^2), 0)
rm(near_matrix)
all_sq <- (n - 1) * log_d^2 - 2 * log_d * (sum(log_d) - log_d) + (sum(log_d^2) - log_d^2)
if (any(!is.finite(all_sq) | all_sq <= 0)) stop("Invalid local variogram normalization")
map_pts$Neighbors <- near_n
map_pts$Local_vario <- ifelse(near_n > 0, (near_sq / pmax(near_n, 1)) / (all_sq / (n - 1)),
                              NA_real_)
map_pts$Local_shown <- ifelse(near_n >= MIN_LOCAL_NEIGHBORS, map_pts$Local_vario, NA_real_)
if (USE_DEM) {
  slope_masked <- terra::mask(ras[["slope"]], terra::vect(win_sf))
  rdf <- terra::as.data.frame(slope_masked, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  map_raster <- data.frame(X = rdf[[1]], Y = rdf[[2]], Value = rdf[[3]])
  raster_title <- paste0("Slope at ", DEM_SCALE_M, " m context (degrees)")
  MAP_D_TEXT <- paste0("Terrain slope at ", DEM_SCALE_M, " m context.")
} else {
  im_k <- spatstat.explore::density.ppp(Xpp, sigma = PCF_SIGMA_M, edge = TRUE, dimyx = 256)
  idf <- as.data.frame(im_k)
  idf <- idf[is.finite(idf$value), ]
  map_raster <- data.frame(X = idf$x + origin[1], Y = idf$y + origin[2], Value = idf$value * 1e6)
  raster_title <- paste0("Kernel intensity, bandwidth ", PCF_SIGMA_M, " m (terraces per km2)")
  MAP_D_TEXT <- paste0("Kernel intensity at a ", PCF_SIGMA_M, " m bandwidth.")
}
if (!nrow(map_raster) || any(!is.finite(map_raster$Value))) stop("Invalid map raster")
map_xlim <- as.numeric(bb[c("xmin", "xmax")])
map_ylim <- as.numeric(bb[c("ymin", "ymax")])
map_ylim[1] <- map_ylim[1] - 0.2 * diff(map_ylim)
map_layers <- function() {
  list(geom_polygon(data = region_hulls, aes(X, Y, group = Region), fill = NA,
                    colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", inherit.aes = FALSE),
       geom_sf(data = win_sf, fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.35, inherit.aes = FALSE),
       geom_point(data = region_labels, aes(X, Y), shape = 21, fill = "white",
                  colour = "black", size = 3.4, stroke = 0.25, inherit.aes = FALSE),
       geom_text(data = region_labels, aes(X, Y, label = Region), size = 2.3,
                 fontface = "bold", colour = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE),
       ggspatial::annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.4, text_cex = 0.6,
                                   height = grid::unit(0.18, "cm")),
       ggspatial::annotation_north_arrow(location = "bl", which_north = "true",
                                         pad_x = grid::unit(0.0, "in"),
                                         pad_y = grid::unit(0.2, "in"),
                                         height = grid::unit(0.9, "cm"),
                                         width = grid::unit(0.9, "cm"),
                                         style = ggspatial::north_arrow_fancy_orienteering),
       coord_sf(crs = sf::st_crs(EXPECTED_CRS), xlim = map_xlim, ylim = map_ylim, datum = NA),
       theme_v7(),
       theme(axis.title = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(),
             axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.border = element_blank(),
             panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(),
             legend.key.width = grid::unit(7, "mm"), legend.key.height = grid::unit(2.6, "mm")))
}
class_order <- order(match(as.character(map_pts$Class), levels(map_pts$Class)[c(3, 2, 4, 1, 5)]))
```

```{r chunk-23-fig5-pcf}
# 23. Figure 5 pcf
make_envelope <- function(obs, sims, x, label) {
  stopifnot(length(obs) == length(x), ncol(sims) == length(x), all(is.finite(obs)),
            all(is.finite(sims)))
  cs <- GET::create_curve_set(list(r = x, obs = obs, sim_m = t(sims)))
  e <- GET::global_envelope_test(cs, type = "erl", alternative = "two.sided", alpha = ALPHA)
  p <- as.numeric(attr(e, "p"))
  if (length(p) != 1L || !is.finite(p)) stop("Global envelope p value unavailable for ", label)
  data.frame(Test = label, Distance_m = x, Observed = as.numeric(e$obs),
             Reference = as.numeric(e$central), Low = as.numeric(e$lo), High = as.numeric(e$hi),
             P_global = p, B = nrow(sims), Outside = obs < e$lo | obs > e$hi)
}
pcf_curve <- function(P, sigma, bw, r, correction, zero = "convolution") {
  lam <- spatstat.explore::density.ppp(P, sigma = sigma, at = "points", edge = TRUE,
                                       leaveoneout = TRUE)
  lam <- pmax(as.numeric(lam), P$n / spatstat.geom::area.owin(P$window) * 1e-4)
  f <- spatstat.explore::pcfinhom(P, lambda = lam, r = r, bw = bw, correction = correction,
                                  divisor = "d", kernel = "epanechnikov", zerocor = zero,
                                  adaptive = FALSE, renormalise = TRUE, normpower = 2)
  z <- if (correction == "translate") f$trans else f$iso
  if (length(z) != length(r) || any(!is.finite(z[-1L]))) stop("Invalid PCF estimate")
  as.numeric(z[-1L])
}
environment(pcf_curve) <- baseenv()
fit_intensity <- function(P, sigma) {
  im <- spatstat.explore::density.ppp(P, sigma = sigma, edge = TRUE, dimyx = 256)
  ok <- is.finite(im$v)
  im$v[ok] <- pmax(im$v[ok], P$n / spatstat.geom::area.owin(P$window) * 1e-4)
  im
}
environment(fit_intensity) <- baseenv()
sim_kernel <- function(n, intensity, win) {
  P <- spatstat.random::rpoint(n, f = intensity, win = win, forcewin = TRUE)
  if (P$n != n || !identical(P$window$type, win$type) ||
      abs(spatstat.geom::area.owin(P$window) - spatstat.geom::area.owin(win)) > 1e-6 ||
      !all(spatstat.geom::inside.owin(P$x, P$y, win))) {
    stop("Kernel simulation did not retain the observation window")
  }
  P
}
environment(sim_kernel) <- baseenv()
pcf_step <- function(k, p) {
  s <- p$simulate(p$n, p$intensity, p$window)
  p$curve(s, p$sigma, p$bw, p$r, p$correction, p$zero)
}
run_pcf <- function(sigma, bw, correction, B, seed, label, r = PCF_R_M, zero = "convolution") {
  obs <- pcf_curve(Xpp, sigma, bw, r, correction, zero)
  sim <- mc_run(B, pcf_step, list(n = n, intensity = fit_intensity(Xpp, sigma), window = W,
                                  sigma = sigma, bw = bw, r = r, correction = correction,
                                  zero = zero, curve = pcf_curve, simulate = sim_kernel),
                seed, label)
  out <- make_envelope(obs, sim, r[-1L], label)
  attr(out, "simulation_matrix") <- sim
  out
}
pcf_main <- run_pcf(PCF_SIGMA_M, PCF_BW_M, "translate", N_SIM, SEED + 100000L,
                    "Broad PCF, kernel intensity")
cal_step <- function(k, p) {
  z <- p$simulate(p$n, p$im, p$W)
  obs <- p$curve(z, p$sigma, p$bw, p$r, "translate")
  iz <- p$intensity(z, p$sigma)
  inner <- replicate(p$inner, {
    zz <- p$simulate(p$n, iz, p$W)
    p$curve(zz, p$sigma, p$bw, p$r, "translate")
  })
  p$score(obs, t(inner))$score
}
max_discrepancy <- function(obs, sim) {
  center <- colMeans(sim)
  scale <- apply(sim, 2L, stats::sd)
  scale <- pmax(scale, 1e-8 * pmax(1, abs(center)))
  if (length(obs) != length(center) || any(!is.finite(c(obs, center, scale)))) {
    stop("Invalid calibration curves")
  }
  list(score = max(abs((obs - center) / scale)), center = center, scale = scale)
}
environment(max_discrepancy) <- baseenv()
pcf_calibrated <- NULL
calibration <- data.frame(Status = "disabled", Outer = 0L, Inner = 0L, P = NA_real_,
                          Observed_score = NA_real_, Critical_score = NA_real_)
if (RUN_CALIBRATION) {
  obs_cal <- max_discrepancy(pcf_main$Observed,
                             attr(pcf_main, "simulation_matrix")[seq_len(N_CAL_INNER), ,
                                                                 drop = FALSE])
  outer_scores <- as.numeric(mc_run(N_CAL_OUTER, cal_step,
                                    list(n = n, im = fit_intensity(Xpp, PCF_SIGMA_M), W = W,
                                         curve = pcf_curve, intensity = fit_intensity,
                                         sigma = PCF_SIGMA_M, bw = PCF_BW_M, r = PCF_R_M,
                                         inner = N_CAL_INNER, simulate = sim_kernel,
                                         score = max_discrepancy),
                                    SEED + 1800000L, "Broad PCF, nested calibration"))
  p_cal <- (1 + sum(outer_scores >= obs_cal$score)) / (N_CAL_OUTER + 1)
  crit_index <- ceiling((N_CAL_OUTER + 1) * (1 - ALPHA))
  crit <- if (crit_index <= N_CAL_OUTER) sort(outer_scores)[crit_index] else Inf
  outside_cal <- abs((pcf_main$Observed - obs_cal$center) / obs_cal$scale) > crit
  if (!identical(p_cal <= ALPHA, any(outside_cal))) {
    stop("Calibrated p value and envelope disagree")
  }
  pcf_calibrated <- data.frame(Test = "Broad PCF, kernel intensity, calibrated",
                               Distance_m = pcf_main$Distance_m, Observed = pcf_main$Observed,
                               Reference = obs_cal$center,
                               Low = obs_cal$center - crit * obs_cal$scale,
                               High = obs_cal$center + crit * obs_cal$scale, P_global = p_cal,
                               B = N_CAL_OUTER, Outside = outside_cal)
  calibration <- data.frame(Status = "nested", Outer = N_CAL_OUTER, Inner = N_CAL_INNER,
                            P = p_cal, Observed_score = obs_cal$score, Critical_score = crit)
}
PCF_FINE_BW_M <- 0.15 / sqrt(n / spatstat.geom::area.owin(W)) / sqrt(5)
lam_cv <- pmax(as.numeric(spatstat.explore::density.ppp(Xpp, sigma = PCF_SIGMA_M, at = "points",
                                                        edge = TRUE, leaveoneout = TRUE)),
               n / spatstat.geom::area.owin(W) * 1e-4)
bw_cv <- tryCatch(as.numeric(spatstat.explore::bw.pcfinhom(Xpp, lambda = lam_cv,
                                                           rmax = max(PCF_FINE_R_M),
                                                           cv.method = "compLik",
                                                           kernel = "epanechnikov",
                                                           divisor = "d",
                                                           zerocor = "convolution"))[1],
                  error = function(e) NA_real_)
if (!is.finite(bw_cv) || bw_cv <= 0) bw_cv <- NA_real_
pcf_fine <- run_pcf(PCF_SIGMA_M, PCF_FINE_BW_M, "translate", N_SIM, SEED + 2600000L,
                    "Fine PCF, kernel intensity", PCF_FINE_R_M)
pcf_fine_jf <- run_pcf(PCF_SIGMA_M, PCF_FINE_BW_M, "translate", N_SENS, SEED + 2620000L,
                       "Fine PCF, Jones-Foster correction", PCF_FINE_R_M, "JonesFoster")
pcf_fine_cv <- if (is.finite(bw_cv)) {
  run_pcf(PCF_SIGMA_M, bw_cv, "translate", N_SENS, SEED + 2640000L,
          "Fine PCF, cross-validated bandwidth", PCF_FINE_R_M)
} else NULL
pcf_fine_wide <- run_pcf(PCF_SIGMA_M, 1.5 * PCF_FINE_BW_M, "translate", N_SENS,
                         SEED + 2660000L, "Fine PCF, 1.5 times bandwidth", PCF_FINE_R_M)
```

```{r chunk-24-fig5-models}
# 24. Figure 5 models
trend <- if (USE_DEM_INTENSITY) ~ elev + slope + tpi else ~ I(x / 1000) + I(y / 1000)
environment(trend) <- baseenv()
trend_label <- if (USE_DEM_INTENSITY) "terrain trend" else "coordinate trend"
model_cov <- if (length(terrain_cov)) terrain_cov else NULL
fit_poisson <- function(P, tr, cov) spatstat.model::ppm(P, trend = tr, covariates = cov)
environment(fit_poisson) <- baseenv()
fit_thomas <- function(P, tr, cov) {
  spatstat.model::kppm(P, trend = tr, covariates = cov, clusters = "Thomas", statistic = "K")
}
environment(fit_thomas) <- baseenv()
poisson_fit <- fit_poisson(Xpp, trend, model_cov)
thomas_fit <- tryCatch(fit_thomas(Xpp, trend, model_cov), error = function(e) e)
model_curve <- function(P, tr, cov, bw, r) {
  m <- spatstat.model::ppm(P, trend = tr, covariates = cov)
  z <- spatstat.explore::pcfinhom(P, lambda = m, update = FALSE, leaveoneout = FALSE, r = r,
                                  bw = bw, correction = "translate", divisor = "d",
                                  kernel = "epanechnikov", zerocor = "convolution",
                                  adaptive = FALSE, renormalise = TRUE, normpower = 2)
  as.numeric(z$trans[-1L])
}
environment(model_curve) <- baseenv()
model_step <- function(k, p) {
  if (!requireNamespace("spatstat.model", quietly = TRUE)) stop("spatstat.model is unavailable")
  P <- stats::simulate(p$fit, nsim = 1, drop = TRUE)
  if (!inherits(P, "ppp")) P <- P[[1L]]
  p$curve(P, p$trend, p$cov, p$bw, p$r)
}
run_model <- function(fit, label, seed, bw = PCF_BW_M, r = PCF_R_M) {
  sims <- mc_run(N_MODEL, model_step, list(fit = fit, curve = model_curve, trend = trend,
                                           cov = model_cov, bw = bw, r = r), seed, label)
  make_envelope(model_curve(Xpp, trend, model_cov, bw, r), sims, r[-1L], label)
}
poisson_diag <- run_model(poisson_fit, paste("Broad PCF, Poisson,", trend_label),
                          SEED + 2100000L)
thomas_diag <- NULL
thomas_fine <- NULL
thomas_par <- NULL
if (!inherits(thomas_fit, "error")) {
  thomas_diag <- run_model(thomas_fit, paste("Broad PCF, Thomas,", trend_label), SEED + 2200000L)
  thomas_fine <- run_model(thomas_fit, paste("Fine PCF, Thomas,", trend_label), SEED + 2680000L,
                           PCF_FINE_BW_M, PCF_FINE_R_M)
  cp <- thomas_fit$clustpar
  if (!is.null(cp)) {
    parents <- cp[["kappa"]] * spatstat.geom::area.owin(W)
    thomas_par <- data.frame(Kappa_per_km2 = cp[["kappa"]] * 1e6, Scale_m = cp[["scale"]],
                             Parents = parents, Mean_cluster_size = n / parents)
  }
}
```

```{r chunk-25-fig5-sensitivity}
orientation_stat <- function(P) {
  cp <- spatstat.geom::closepairs(P, rmax = 500, twice = FALSE, what = "all")
  ok <- cp$d >= 100
  a <- (atan2(cp$dy[ok], cp$dx[ok]) * 180 / pi) %% 180
  v <- tabulate(findInterval(a, seq(0, 180, 30)), 6L)
  if (!sum(v)) stop("No pairs in the orientation domain")
  v / sum(v)
}
environment(orientation_stat) <- baseenv()
orientation_step <- function(k, p) p$stat(p$simulate(p$n, p$intensity, p$W))
ori_sim <- mc_run(N_SENS, orientation_step, list(n = n, intensity = fit_intensity(Xpp, PCF_SIGMA_M),
                                                 W = W, stat = orientation_stat,
                                                 simulate = sim_kernel),
                  SEED + 2500000L, "Pair orientation")
ori <- make_envelope(orientation_stat(Xpp), ori_sim, seq(15, 165, 30), "Pair orientation")
```

```{r chunk-28-fig5-report}
          P = fmt_p(vapply(pcf_sens, function(e) e$P_global[1], numeric(1))),
          OUTSIDE_M = vapply(pcf_sens, function(e) outside_runs(e$Distance_m, e$Outside),
                             character(1)),
          G_AT_20_100_M = vapply(pcf_sens, function(e) vector_text(value_at(e, c(20, 100)), 4),
                                 character(1)))
emit_rows(SECTOR_DEG = paste0(seq(0, 150, 30), "-", seq(30, 180, 30)),
          SHARE = fmt_num(ori$Observed, 3), REFERENCE = fmt_num(ori$Reference, 3),
          ENVELOPE_95 = interval_text(ori$Low, ori$High, 3))
emit_rows(ORIENTATION_P = fmt_p(ori$P_global[1]))
emit_text("NOTE", paste("Pair orientations refer to center-to-center directions between 100 and",
```

```{r chunk-30-fig6-functions}
# 30. Figure 6 functions
make_pairs <- function(keep = seq_len(n), breaks = MARK_BREAKS_M, correction = "none",
                       lower = 0) {
  sub <- DM[keep, keep, drop = FALSE]
  ij <- which(upper.tri(sub) & sub <= max(breaks) & sub >= lower, arr.ind = TRUE)
  i <- ij[, 1]; j <- ij[, 2]; ds <- sub[ij]
  b <- findInterval(ds, breaks, rightmost.closed = TRUE)
  valid <- b >= 1L & b < length(breaks)
  i <- i[valid]; j <- j[valid]; ds <- ds[valid]; b <- b[valid]
  w <- rep(1, length(b))
  if (correction == "border") {
    w <- (as.numeric(edge_m[keep[i]] >= breaks[b + 1L]) +
            as.numeric(edge_m[keep[j]] >= breaks[b + 1L])) / 2
  }
  counts <- vapply(seq_len(length(breaks) - 1L), function(g) sum(b == g & w > 0), integer(1))
  vertices <- vapply(seq_len(length(breaks) - 1L), function(g) {
    at <- b == g & w > 0
    length(unique(c(i[at], j[at])))
  }, integer(1))
  support <- data.frame(Band = seq_along(counts), Lower_m = breaks[-length(breaks)],
                        Upper_m = breaks[-1L], Pairs = counts, Terraces = vertices)
  support$Used <- counts >= MIN_PAIRS_PER_BAND & vertices >= MIN_TERRACES_PER_BAND
  if (sum(support$Used) < 2L) stop("Fewer than two supported distance bands")
  ok <- w > 0 & b %in% support$Band[support$Used]
  i <- i[ok]; j <- j[ok]; ds <- ds[ok]; b <- b[ok]; w <- w[ok]
  o <- order(b)
  i <- i[o]; j <- j[o]; b <- b[o]; w <- w[o]; ds <- ds[o]
  meta <- support[support$Used, ]
  meta$Midpoint_m <- (meta$Lower_m + meta$Upper_m) / 2
  if (lower > FIXED_DOMAIN_M[1]) stop("The fixed domain conflicts with the lower distance cutoff")
  fi <- which(upper.tri(sub) & sub >= FIXED_DOMAIN_M[1] & sub <= FIXED_DOMAIN_M[2], arr.ind = TRUE)
  fw <- rep(1, nrow(fi))
  if (correction == "border") {
    fw <- (as.numeric(edge_m[keep[fi[, 1]]] >= FIXED_DOMAIN_M[2]) +
             as.numeric(edge_m[keep[fi[, 2]]] >= FIXED_DOMAIN_M[2])) / 2
  }
  good <- fw > 0
  ni <- which(upper.tri(sub) & sub >= max(0, lower) & sub < NEAR_MAX_M, arr.ind = TRUE)
  nw <- rep(1, nrow(ni))
  if (correction == "border") {
    nw <- (as.numeric(edge_m[keep[ni[, 1]]] >= NEAR_MAX_M) +
             as.numeric(edge_m[keep[ni[, 2]]] >= NEAR_MAX_M)) / 2
  }
  ng <- nw > 0
  list(near_i = ni[ng, 1], near_j = ni[ng, 2], near_w = nw[ng], near_lower = lower,
       i = i, j = j, w = w, b = b, den = as.numeric(rowsum(w, b, reorder = FALSE)),
       meta = meta, support = support, keep = keep,
       fi = fi[good, 1], fj = fi[good, 2], fw = fw[good])
}
mark_stats <- function(d, pair) {
  m <- log(d); a <- pair$i; b <- pair$j
  v <- stats::var(m); mu <- mean(d)
  product_ref <- (sum(d)^2 - sum(d^2)) / (length(d) * (length(d) - 1))
  z <- cbind((m[a] - m[b])^2 / (2 * v), (d[a] + d[b]) / (2 * mu), d[a] * d[b] / product_ref)
  old <- rowsum(z * pair$w, pair$b, reorder = FALSE) / pair$den
  mom <- rowsum(cbind((m[a] + m[b]) / 2, (m[a]^2 + m[b]^2) / 2, m[a] * m[b]) * pair$w,
                pair$b, reorder = FALSE) / pair$den
  center <- mom[, 1]
  V <- (mom[, 2] - center^2) / v
  C <- (mom[, 3] - center^2) / v
  if (max(abs(old[, 1] - (V - C))) > 1e-9) stop("Variogram identity failed")
  as.numeric(cbind(old, center, V, C))
}
environment(mark_stats) <- baseenv()
mark_step <- function(k, p) {
  d <- p$d
  for (g in p$groups) d[g] <- p$d[g[sample.int(length(g))]]
  z <- p$stat(d, p$pair)
  ov <- sum(p$close_dist < (d[p$close_i] + d[p$close_j]) / 2)
  fixed <- sum(p$pair$fw * (log(d[p$pair$fi]) - log(d[p$pair$fj]))^2) /
    (2 * stats::var(log(d)) * sum(p$pair$fw))
  near <- if (length(p$pair$near_w)) {
    sum(p$pair$near_w * (log(d[p$pair$near_i]) - log(d[p$pair$near_j]))^2) /
      (2 * stats::var(log(d)) * sum(p$pair$near_w))
  } else 0
  same <- vapply(p$equal_pairs, function(q) sum(d[q[, 1]] == d[q[, 2]]), numeric(1))
  c(z, fixed, near, ov, same)
}
run_marks <- function(pair, B, seed, label, restricted = FALSE) {
  d <- D[pair$keep]
  groups <- if (restricted) split(seq_along(d), regions[pair$keep]) else list(seq_along(d))
  dm <- DM[pair$keep, pair$keep, drop = FALSE]
  close <- which(upper.tri(dm) & dm < max(d), arr.ind = TRUE)
  eq <- lapply(list(c(0, 1), c(0, 2), c(2, 5)), function(r)
    which(upper.tri(dm) & dm >= r[1] & dm < r[2], arr.ind = TRUE))
  p <- list(d = d, pair = pair, stat = mark_stats, groups = groups, close_i = close[, 1],
            close_j = close[, 2], close_dist = dm[close], equal_pairs = eq)
  obs <- mark_stats(d, pair)
  sims <- mc_run(B, mark_step, p, seed, label)
  meta <- pair$meta
  K <- nrow(meta)
  blk <- function(k) (k - 1L) * K + seq_len(K)
  shape <- function(e, fun) {
    e$Distance_m <- rep(meta$Midpoint_m, length(fun))
    e$Band <- rep(seq_len(K), length(fun))
    e$Lower_m <- rep(meta$Lower_m, length(fun))
    e$Upper_m <- rep(meta$Upper_m, length(fun))
    e$Function <- rep(fun, each = K)
    e
  }
  joint <- shape(make_envelope(obs[c(blk(1), blk(2))], sims[, c(blk(1), blk(2)), drop = FALSE],
                               seq_len(2L * K), label), c("Variogram", "Mean diameter"))
  decomp <- shape(make_envelope(obs[c(blk(5), blk(6))], sims[, c(blk(5), blk(6)), drop = FALSE],
                                seq_len(2L * K), label),
                  c("Conditional variance", "Conditional covariance"))
  product <- make_envelope(obs[blk(3)], sims[, blk(3), drop = FALSE], meta$Midpoint_m, label)
  identity_error <- max(abs(sims[, blk(1), drop = FALSE] -
                              (sims[, blk(5), drop = FALSE] - sims[, blk(6), drop = FALSE])))
  stopifnot(identity_error < 1e-9)
  rho_sim <- sims[, blk(6), drop = FALSE] / sims[, blk(5), drop = FALSE]
  rho <- data.frame(Band = seq_len(K), Observed = obs[blk(6)] / obs[blk(5)],
                    Low = apply(rho_sim, 2, stats::quantile, .025),
                    High = apply(rho_sim, 2, stats::quantile, .975))
  eq_obs <- vapply(eq, function(q) sum(d[q[, 1]] == d[q[, 2]]), numeric(1))
  eq_sim <- sims[, 6L * K + 3L + seq_along(eq), drop = FALSE]
  equal_marks <- data.frame(Domain = c("0-1 m", "0-2 m", "2-5 m"),
                            Pairs = vapply(eq, nrow, integer(1)), Identical = eq_obs,
                            Expected = colMeans(eq_sim),
                            P_upper = (1 + colSums(eq_sim >= matrix(eq_obs, nrow(eq_sim),
                                                                    length(eq), byrow = TRUE))) /
                              (B + 1))
  ov_obs <- sum(p$close_dist < (d[p$close_i] + d[p$close_j]) / 2)
  ov_sim <- sims[, 6L * K + 3L]
  list(curves = joint, decomposition = decomp, product = product, rho = rho,
       equal_marks = equal_marks, identity_error = identity_error, pair = pair, K = K,
       log_mean = data.frame(Band = seq_len(K), Observed = obs[blk(4)],
                             Null = colMeans(sims[, blk(4), drop = FALSE])),
       overlap = data.frame(Observed = ov_obs, Null_median = stats::median(ov_sim),
                            Null_low = qv(ov_sim, .025), Null_high = qv(ov_sim, .975),
                            P = mc_p(ov_obs, ov_sim)),
       fixed_obs = sum(pair$fw * (log(d[pair$fi]) - log(d[pair$fj]))^2) /
         (2 * stats::var(log(d)) * sum(pair$fw)),
       fixed_sim = sims[, 6L * K + 1L], near_sim = sims[, 6L * K + 2L],
       near_obs = if (length(pair$near_w)) {
         sum(pair$near_w * (log(d[pair$near_i]) - log(d[pair$near_j]))^2) /
           (2 * stats::var(log(d)) * sum(pair$near_w))
       } else NA_real_)
}
near_effect <- function(res, label) {
  sim <- res$near_sim
  ref <- mean(sim)
  ok <- length(res$pair$near_w) >= MIN_PAIRS_PER_BAND &&
    length(unique(c(res$pair$near_i, res$pair$near_j))) >= MIN_TERRACES_PER_BAND &&
    is.finite(ref) && ref > 0
  data.frame(Scenario = label, N = length(res$pair$keep), Distance_min_m = res$pair$near_lower,
             Pairs = length(res$pair$near_w), Supported = ok,
             Observed_ratio = if (ok) res$near_obs / ref else NA_real_,
             Null_low_ratio = if (ok) qv(sim, .025) / ref else NA_real_,
             Null_high_ratio = if (ok) qv(sim, .975) / ref else NA_real_,
             P_scalar = if (ok) mc_p(res$near_obs, sim) else NA_real_, B = length(sim))
}
fixed_effect <- function(res, label) {
  sim <- res$fixed_sim
  ref <- mean(sim)
  data.frame(Scenario = label, Pairs = length(res$pair$fi), Observed_ratio = res$fixed_obs / ref,
             Null_low_ratio = qv(sim, .025) / ref, Null_high_ratio = qv(sim, .975) / ref)
}
mark_long <- function(res, null_label) {
  out <- rbind(res$curves, res$decomposition)
  out$Null <- null_label
  out
}
mark_plot <- function(df, max_upper) {
  df <- df[df$Upper_m <= max_upper, ]
  meta <- unique(df[, c("Band", "Lower_m", "Upper_m")])
  meta <- meta[order(meta$Band), ]
  refs <- data.frame(Function = factor(levels(df$Function), levels = levels(df$Function)),
                     y = c(1, 1, 1, 0))
  ggplot(df, aes(Band, Observed)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Low, ymax = High, fill = Null)) +
    geom_hline(data = refs, aes(yintercept = y), linetype = "dotted", colour = COL[["neutral"]],
               linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Reference), colour = COL[["reference"]], linetype = "dashed",
              linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_line(colour = COL[["observed"]], linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = Outside), size = 1.7) +
    facet_grid(Function ~ Null, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = meta$Band, labels = band_text(meta)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Global labeling" = tint(COL[["global"]], 0.72),
                                 "Within-region labeling" = tint(COL[["regional"]], 0.68)),
                      guide = "none") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("FALSE" = COL[["observed"]], "TRUE" = COL[["outside"]]),
                        labels = c("FALSE" = "Within 95% envelope",
                                   "TRUE" = "Outside 95% envelope"), name = NULL) +
    labs(x = "Distance band between terrace centers (m)", y = "Normalized statistic") +
    theme_v7() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))
}
```

```{r chunk-36-fig7-regression}
# 36. Figure 7 regression
x <- log1p(primary$Concentration)
y <- log(D)
if (stats::sd(x) == 0) stop("Concentration has no variation")
model0 <- stats::lm(y ~ 1)
model1 <- stats::lm(y ~ x)
fstat <- summary(model1)$fstatistic
ols <- data.frame(Intercept = unname(stats::coef(model1)[1]), Slope = unname(stats::coef(model1)[2]),
                  F = unname(fstat[["value"]]), DF1 = unname(fstat[["numdf"]]),
                  DF2 = unname(fstat[["dendf"]]),
                  P = stats::pf(fstat[["value"]], fstat[["numdf"]], fstat[["dendf"]],
                                lower.tail = FALSE),
                  R2 = summary(model1)$r.squared)
block_ids <- function(width, offset = c(0, 0)) {
  interaction(floor((xy_local[, 1] + offset[1]) / width),
              floor((xy_local[, 2] + offset[2]) / width), drop = TRUE)
}
boot_step <- function(k, p) {
  chosen <- sample.int(length(p$blocks), length(p$blocks), replace = TRUE)
  ii <- unlist(p$blocks[chosen], use.names = FALSE)
  f <- stats::lm.fit(cbind(1, p$x[ii]), p$y[ii])
  b <- f$coefficients[2]
  if (!is.finite(b)) return(c(0, 0, 0, 0))
  c(1, f$coefficients[1], b, 100 * expm1(b * p$dx))
}
boot_model <- function(keep, radius, width, B, seed, offset = c(0, 0)) {
  xx <- log1p(conc[[as.character(radius)]]$Concentration[keep])
  yy <- y[keep]
  dx <- diff(qv(xx, c(.25, .75)))
  blocks <- split(seq_along(keep), droplevels(block_ids(width, offset)[keep]))
  f <- stats::lm.fit(cbind(1, xx), yy)
  if (length(blocks) < 3L || !all(is.finite(f$coefficients))) {
    stop("Insufficient variation for the block bootstrap")
  }
  z <- mc_run(B, boot_step, list(blocks = blocks, x = xx, y = yy, dx = dx), seed,
              paste0("Block bootstrap, radius ", radius, " m, block ", width, " m"))
  good <- z[, 1] == 1
  if (mean(good) < 0.99) stop("More than 1 percent of bootstrap fits are singular")
  z <- z[good, , drop = FALSE]
  beta <- unname(f$coefficients[2])
  list(summary = data.frame(Radius_m = radius, Block_m = width, Blocks = length(blocks),
                            Beta = beta, Beta_low = qv(z[, 3], .025), Beta_high = qv(z[, 3], .975),
                            Effect = 100 * expm1(beta * dx), Effect_low = qv(z[, 4], .025),
                            Effect_high = qv(z[, 4], .975)),
       draws = z, dx = dx)
}
boot_main <- boot_model(seq_len(n), PRIMARY_RADIUS_M, BOOT_BLOCK_M, N_BOOT, SEED + 400000L)
slope_step <- function(k, p) {
  yy <- p$y
  for (g in p$groups) yy[g] <- p$y[g[sample.int(length(g))]]
  sum((p$x - mean(p$x)) * (yy - mean(yy))) / sum((p$x - mean(p$x))^2)
}
slope_global <- mc_run(N_PERM, slope_step, list(x = x, y = y, groups = list(seq_len(n))),
                       SEED + 500000L, "Slope, global labeling")
slope_regional <- mc_run(N_PERM, slope_step, list(x = x, y = y, groups = split(seq_len(n), regions)),
                         SEED + 600000L, "Slope, within-region labeling")
slope_p <- c(Global = mc_p(ols$Slope, slope_global), Regional = mc_p(ols$Slope, slope_regional))
effect_log <- boot_main$draws[, 3] * boot_main$dx
contrast <- data.frame(Log_SD = stats::sd(y),
                       Standardized = ols$Slope * boot_main$dx / stats::sd(y),
                       Standardized_low = qv(effect_log / stats::sd(y), .025),
                       Standardized_high = qv(effect_log / stats::sd(y), .975),
                       Difference_m = 10 * expm1(ols$Slope * boot_main$dx),
                       Difference_low = qv(10 * expm1(effect_log), .025),
                       Difference_high = qv(10 * expm1(effect_log), .975))
xg <- seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = 120)
pred_draws <- exp(outer(boot_main$draws[, 3], xg, "*") + boot_main$draws[, 2])
fit_grid <- data.frame(C = expm1(xg), Fit = exp(ols$Intercept + ols$Slope * xg),
                       Low = apply(pred_draws, 2, stats::quantile, .025),
                       High = apply(pred_draws, 2, stats::quantile, .975))
z_std <- stats::rstandard(model1)
lag_matrix <- DM <= LAG_RADIUS_M
lag_n <- rowSums(lag_matrix)
lag_mean <- ifelse(lag_n > 0, as.numeric(lag_matrix %*% z_std) / pmax(lag_n, 1L), NA_real_)
rm(lag_matrix)
lag_cor <- stats::cor(z_std, lag_mean, use = "complete.obs")
```

```{r chunk-37-fig7-validation}
# 37. Figure 7 validation
set.seed(SEED + 700000L)
cv_block <- stats::kmeans(xy_local, centers = CV_BLOCKS, nstart = 25, iter.max = 200)$cluster
make_partitions <- function() {
  out <- list()
  keys <- character()
  attempt <- 0L
  while (length(out) < CV_REPEATS && attempt < 1000L) {
    attempt <- attempt + 1L
    set.seed(SEED + 710000L + attempt)
    fd <- sample(rep(seq_len(CV_FOLDS), length.out = CV_BLOCKS))[cv_block]
    key <- paste(match(fd, unique(fd)), collapse = ",")
    if (!key %in% keys) {
      out[[length(out) + 1L]] <- fd
      keys <- c(keys, key)
    }
  }
  if (length(out) != CV_REPEATS) stop("Distinct spatial partitions could not be built")
  out
}
partitions <- make_partitions()
cv_step <- function(k, p) {
  fd <- p$folds[[k]]
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, length(fd), 2L)
  min_sep <- Inf
  for (f in seq_len(p$K)) {
    te <- which(fd == f)
    tr0 <- which(fd != f)
    tr <- tr0[apply(p$dist[tr0, te, drop = FALSE], 1, min) >= p$buffer]
    if (length(tr) < 30L || length(te) < 1L) stop("Insufficient fold after buffering")
    for (j in 1:2) {
      M <- if (j == 1L) p$Z0 else p$Z1
      m <- stats::lm.fit(M[tr, , drop = FALSE], p$y[tr])
      if (any(!is.finite(m$coefficients))) stop("Singular cross-validation fit")
      out[te, j] <- exp(M[te, , drop = FALSE] %*% m$coefficients + stats::median(m$residuals))
    }
    min_sep <- min(min_sep, min(p$dist[tr, te, drop = FALSE]))
  }
  if (any(!is.finite(out))) stop("Incomplete held-out predictions")
  mae <- colMeans(abs(exp(p$y) - out))
  c(mae, mae[1] - mae[2], min_sep)
}
run_cv <- function(Z0, Z1, seed, label) {
  mc_run(CV_REPEATS, cv_step, list(folds = partitions, K = CV_FOLDS, Z0 = Z0, Z1 = Z1, y = y,
                                   dist = DM, buffer = CV_BUFFER_M), seed, label)
}
cv_conc <- run_cv(matrix(1, n, 1), cbind(1, x), SEED + 720000L,
                  "Cross-validation, concentration")
resid_stat <- function(z, pair) {
  v <- stats::var(z)
  as.numeric(rowsum(pair$w * (z[pair$i] - z[pair$j])^2 / (2 * v), pair$b, reorder = FALSE)) /
    pair$den
}
environment(resid_stat) <- baseenv()
resid_near_stat <- function(z, pair) {
  sum(pair$near_w * (z[pair$near_i] - z[pair$near_j])^2) / (2 * stats::var(z) * sum(pair$near_w))
}
environment(resid_near_stat) <- baseenv()
signflip_step <- function(k, p) {
  ys <- p$fitted + p$adjusted * sample(c(-1, 1), length(p$adjusted), replace = TRUE)
  f <- stats::lm.fit(p$X, ys)
  c(p$stat(f$residuals, p$pair), p$near(f$residuals, p$pair))
}
run_residual <- function(model, label, seed) {
  r <- stats::residuals(model)
  adjusted <- r / sqrt(pmax(1 - stats::hatvalues(model), 1e-6))
  sims <- mc_run(N_SIM, signflip_step, list(fitted = stats::fitted(model), adjusted = adjusted,
                                            X = stats::model.matrix(model), stat = resid_stat,
                                            near = resid_near_stat, pair = pair_main),
                 seed, paste("Sign-flip residual resampling,", label))
  K <- nrow(pair_main$meta)
  curve <- make_envelope(resid_stat(r, pair_main), sims[, seq_len(K), drop = FALSE],
                         pair_main$meta$Midpoint_m, label)
  curve$Band <- seq_len(K)
  curve$Upper_m <- pair_main$meta$Upper_m
  curve$Model <- label
  near_obs <- resid_near_stat(r, pair_main)
  near_sim <- sims[, K + 1L]
  list(curve = curve,
       near = data.frame(Model = label, Ratio = near_obs / mean(near_sim),
                         Null_low = qv(near_sim, .025) / mean(near_sim),
                         Null_high = qv(near_sim, .975) / mean(near_sim),
                         P = mc_p(near_obs, near_sim), P_global = curve$P_global[1],
                         R2 = summary(model)$r.squared))
}
res_m1 <- run_residual(model1, "M1 concentration", SEED + 800000L)
res_m2 <- NULL
res_m3 <- NULL
terrain_coef <- NULL
cv_terrain <- NULL
if (USE_DEM_MARKS) {
  tdat <- data.frame(y = y, x = x, terrain_at)
  model2 <- stats::lm(y ~ elev + slope + tpi, data = tdat)
  model3 <- stats::lm(y ~ x + elev + slope + tpi, data = tdat)
  res_m2 <- run_residual(model2, "M2 terrain", SEED + 2700000L)
  res_m3 <- run_residual(model3, "M3 concentration and terrain", SEED + 2300000L)
  boot_lm_step <- function(k, p) {
    chosen <- sample.int(length(p$blocks), length(p$blocks), replace = TRUE)
    ii <- unlist(p$blocks[chosen], use.names = FALSE)
    b <- stats::lm.fit(p$X[ii, , drop = FALSE], p$y[ii])$coefficients
    if (any(!is.finite(b))) return(c(0, rep(0, ncol(p$X))))
    c(1, b)
  }
  boot_coef <- function(model, label, seed) {
    X <- stats::model.matrix(model)
    blocks <- split(seq_len(n), droplevels(block_ids(BOOT_BLOCK_M)))
    z <- mc_run(N_SENS, boot_lm_step, list(blocks = blocks, X = X, y = y), seed,
                paste("Block bootstrap coefficients,", label))
    z <- z[z[, 1] == 1, -1, drop = FALSE]
    data.frame(Model = label, Term = colnames(X), Estimate = unname(stats::coef(model)),
               Low = apply(z, 2, stats::quantile, .025),
               High = apply(z, 2, stats::quantile, .975))
  }
  terrain_coef <- rbind(boot_coef(model2, "M2 terrain", SEED + 2750000L),
                        boot_coef(model3, "M3 concentration and terrain", SEED + 2760000L))
  Zt <- cbind(1, as.matrix(terrain_at))
  cv_terrain <- run_cv(Zt, cbind(Zt, x), SEED + 2400000L, "Cross-validation, terrain")
}
residual_models <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list(res_m1, res_m2, res_m3))
```

```{r chunk-38-fig7-diagnostics}
  chosen <- sample.int(length(p$blocks), length(p$blocks), replace = TRUE)

  stats::cor(p$x[ii], p$y[ii], method = "spearman")
}
rank_boot <- mc_run(N_SENS, rank_step,
                    list(blocks = split(seq_len(n), droplevels(block_ids(BOOT_BLOCK_M))),

                        P = spline_test[["Pr(>F)"]][2])

  vif <- vapply(names(vif_data), function(v) {
    f <- stats::reformulate(setdiff(names(vif_data), v), response = v)
    1 / (1 - summary(stats::lm(f, data = vif_data))$r.squared)
  }, numeric(1))
}
```

```{r chunk-43-fig8-compute}
  list(label = "Beyond maximum diameter", keep = seq_len(n), breaks = MARK_BREAKS_M,

  list(label = "Without upper 1 percent of diameters", keep = which(D <= qv(D, .99)),
       breaks = MARK_BREAKS_M, correction = "none", lower = 0))
for (g in seq_len(LOO_REGIONS)) {
  sc_specs[[length(sc_specs) + 1L]] <- list(label = paste("Omit region", g),
                                            keep = which(regions != g), breaks = MARK_BREAKS_M,
                                            correction = "none", lower = 0)
}

  sc_specs[[length(sc_specs) + 1L]] <- list(label = "Exclude terraces in pairs under 2 m",
                                            keep = keep_no_close, breaks = MARK_BREAKS_M,
                                            correction = "none", lower = 0)
  sc_specs[[length(sc_specs) + 1L]] <- list(label = "One terrace per group under 2 m",
                                            keep = keep_one_close, breaks = MARK_BREAKS_M,

}

  list(near = near_effect(r, s$label), fixed = fixed_effect(r, s$label))
})
```

```{r chunk-44-fig8-plot, fig.height=185 / 25.4}
SAVED_FIGURES <- c(SAVED_FIGURES, save_figure(p8, "FIGURE_8", FIG_HEIGHT_MM[["FIGURE_8"]]))
```

```{r chunk-51-table2-build}
# 51. Table2 build
primary_p <- c(mark_global$curves$P_global[1], mark_regional$curves$P_global[1],
               slope_p[["Global"]], slope_p[["Regional"]], res_m1$near$P_global)
holm <- stats::p.adjust(primary_p, method = "holm")
t2 <- list()
add_row <- function(analysis, reference, estimate, range, p, draws) {
  t2[[length(t2) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(Analysis = analysis, Reference = reference,
                                       Estimate = estimate, Range = range, p = p, Draws = draws)
}
kernel_test <- if (is.null(pcf_calibrated)) pcf_main else pcf_calibrated
add_row("Pair correlation at 20 m",
        if (is.null(pcf_calibrated)) "Kernel intensity" else "Kernel intensity, calibrated",
        fmt_num(value_at(kernel_test, 20), 4), envelope_at(kernel_test, 20),
        fmt_p(kernel_test$P_global[1]),
        if (is.null(pcf_calibrated)) fmt_num(N_SIM) else paste(N_CAL_OUTER, "x", N_CAL_INNER))
if (!is.null(thomas_diag)) {
  add_row("Pair correlation at 20 m", paste("Thomas,", trend_label),
          fmt_num(value_at(thomas_diag, 20), 4), envelope_at(thomas_diag, 20),
          fmt_p(thomas_diag$P_global[1]), fmt_num(N_MODEL))
}
if (!is.null(thomas_fine)) {
  add_row("Fine-scale pair correlation at 5 m", paste("Thomas,", trend_label),
          fmt_num(value_at(thomas_fine, 5), 4), envelope_at(thomas_fine, 5),
          fmt_p(thomas_fine$P_global[1]), fmt_num(N_MODEL))
}
for (k in 1:2) {
  add_row("Variogram ratio, 0 to 50 m", sens_near$Scenario[k],
          fmt_num(sens_near$Observed_ratio[k], 3),
          interval_text(sens_near$Null_low_ratio[k], sens_near$Null_high_ratio[k], 3),
          paste0(fmt_p(primary_p[k]), " (Holm ", fmt_p(holm[k]), ")"), fmt_num(N_PERM))
}
for (k in 1:2) {
  add_row(paste0("Neighbor correlation, ", bt[k], " m"), "Global labeling",
          fmt_num(mark_global$rho$Observed[k], 3),
          interval_text(mark_global$rho$Low[k], mark_global$rho$High[k], 3),
          fmt_p(mark_global$decomposition$P_global[1]), fmt_num(N_PERM))
}
add_row("Concentration contrast, P25 to P75 (%)", "Spatial block bootstrap",
        fmt_num(boot_main$summary$Effect, 3),
        interval_text(boot_main$summary$Effect_low, boot_main$summary$Effect_high, 3),
        paste0(fmt_p(slope_p[["Global"]]), " (Holm ", fmt_p(holm[3]), ")"), fmt_num(N_BOOT))
add_row("Concentration contrast (SD of log diameter)", "Spatial block bootstrap",
        fmt_num(contrast$Standardized, 3),
        interval_text(contrast$Standardized_low, contrast$Standardized_high, 3), "",
        fmt_num(N_BOOT))
for (m in residual_models) {
  add_row("Residual variogram ratio, 0 to 50 m", m$near$Model, fmt_num(m$near$Ratio, 3),
          interval_text(m$near$Null_low, m$near$Null_high, 3),
          if (m$near$Model == "M1 concentration") {
            paste0(fmt_p(m$near$P_global), " (Holm ", fmt_p(holm[5]), ")")
          } else fmt_p(m$near$P_global), fmt_num(N_SIM))
}
add_row("Cross-validated MAE gain (mm)", "Concentration model",
        paste0(fmt_num(1000 * mean(cv_conc[, 3]), 3), " (", sum(cv_conc[, 3] > 0), " of ",
               CV_REPEATS, " positive)"),
        interval_text(1000 * min(cv_conc[, 3]), 1000 * max(cv_conc[, 3]), 3), "",
        fmt_num(CV_REPEATS))
table2 <- do.call(rbind, t2)
names(table2) <- c("Analysis", "Reference", "Estimate", "95% range", "p", "Draws")
```

```{r chunk-55-audit}
# 55. Audit and reproducibility
SAVED_FIGURES <- unique(SAVED_FIGURES)
stopifnot(identical(D_ORIGINAL, D), nrow(terraces) == EXPECTED_TERRACES,
          length(SAVED_FIGURES) == 6L, all(file.exists(SAVED_FIGURES)),
          identical(basename(SAVED_FIGURES), paste0("FIGURE_", 3:8, ".pdf")),
          max(mark_global$identity_error, mark_regional$identity_error) < 1e-9,
          nrow(cv_conc) == CV_REPEATS, all(cv_conc[, 4] >= CV_BUFFER_M))
report_start("Audit", "Checks, inputs, computation and environment", "one line per item")
emit_rows(FIGURE_FOLDER = FIG_DIR, FIGURE_FILES = paste(basename(SAVED_FIGURES), collapse = ", "))
input_files <- c(terrace_path, polygon_path, dem_path)
emit_rows(GITHUB_REPOSITORY = paste(GITHUB_OWNER, GITHUB_REPO, sep = "/"),
          GITHUB_REF = GITHUB_REF, GITHUB_FOLDER = GITHUB_FOLDER)
emit_rows(INPUT = basename(input_files), MD5 = unname(tools::md5sum(input_files)))
emit_rows(MONTE_CARLO_RUNS = nrow(MC_LOG), FROM_CACHE = sum(MC_LOG$Cached),
          COMPUTED = sum(!MC_LOG$Cached), MONTE_CARLO_SECONDS = sum(MC_LOG$Seconds),
          SLOWEST_RUN = MC_LOG$Label[which.max(MC_LOG$Seconds)],
          SLOWEST_SECONDS = max(MC_LOG$Seconds))
emit_rows(CACHE = USE_CACHE, CACHE_DIR = CACHE_DIR)
emit_rows(SEED = SEED, R = R.version.string, PLATFORM = R.version$platform,
          OS = Sys.info()[["sysname"]], WORKERS = CPU_WORKERS)
emit_rows(PACKAGES = paste(vapply(req, function(p)
  paste0(p, " ", as.character(utils::packageVersion(p))), character(1)), collapse = ", "))
emit_rows(MAP_PACKAGE = paste0("ggspatial ", as.character(utils::packageVersion("ggspatial"))))
emit_rows(QUICK_TEST = QUICK_TEST, RESULTS_FOR_INFERENCE = !QUICK_TEST,
          TERRAIN_MARKS = USE_DEM_MARKS, TERRAIN_INTENSITY = USE_DEM_INTENSITY,
          ELAPSED_SECONDS = round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), RUN_STARTED_AT,
                                                      units = "secs")), 1))
if (!is.null(CLUSTER)) {
  parallel::stopCluster(CLUSTER)
  CLUSTER <- NULL
}
```
